A person who is a victim of an 5 assault under subsection 1, 2, 3, or 4 that resulted in the 6 victim coming in contact with the blood, seminal fluid, urine, 7 saliva, or feces of the person committing the assault, when 8 there is reason to believe that the person committing the 9 assault has or may have a communicable disease, may request 10 that law enforcement make application to the court for the 11 issuance of a search warrant, in accordance with chapter 808, 12 for the purpose of requiring the person committing the assault 13 to submit to testing for communicable diseases. 14 b.
